theorems.name: Submission.aestronglyMeasurable_ball_comp_sub
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (h : Rn n → ℝ) (r s : ℝ) (z : Rn n), r + ‖z‖ ≤ s → AEStronglyMeasurable h (volume.restrict (ball (0 : Rn n) s)) → AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => h (x - z)) (volume.restrict (ball (0 : Rn n) r))
